morphology.pattern_note: 整体记忆；e 读 /ə/，j 读 /d͡ʒ/。不能把 sen- 当作现代马来语词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 黄昏；太阳接近落山、白昼即将转入夜晚的时段。
senses.en_definition: Dusk; the evening period around sunset as daylight gives way to night.
senses.ms_definition: Waktu menjelang malam ketika matahari hampir terbenam dan cahaya siang semakin berkurang.
senses.nuances: 涵盖日落前后的暮色时段，不宜限定为太阳落山以后。实际钟点随地点和日期而变。usia senja 借黄昏比喻晚年；senja buta 指天色已经很暗的黄昏。[DBP：senja](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=senja)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Operasi mencari dan menyelamat ditangguhkan apabila senja tiba kerana jarak penglihatan semakin terhad.
dual_scenarios.zh: 黄昏到来后，由于能见度逐渐降低，搜救行动暂停。
dual_scenarios.en: The search and rescue operation was suspended at dusk as visibility deteriorated.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dah senja ni, jom balik dulu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sekarang sudah senja. Mari kita pulang dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 都黄昏了，咱们先回去吧。
dual_scenarios.en: It's getting dark. Let's head home.
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
ni 是 ini 的口语形式，此处指眼下的情况。
jom 用来邀请对方一起行动。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah senja ni, kau masih kat taman ke?
messages.ms_standard: Sekarang sudah senja. Adakah kamu masih berada di taman?
messages.zh: 都黄昏了，你还在公园啊？
messages.en: It's getting dark. Are you still at the park?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, aku nak balik dah. Tunggu adik sekejap je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah hendak pulang. Saya hanya menunggu adik sebentar.
messages.zh: 对啊，我这就准备回了。就等一下我弟弟。
messages.en: Yeah, I'm about to head home. Just waiting a moment for my younger brother.

etymology.historical_story: Senja is traced to Sanskrit sandhyā, a word associated with twilight and the meeting of day and night. Its history connects an everyday Malay time expression with older South Asian vocabulary. In modern Malay, senja remains an indivisible root; its historical origin does not justify splitting it into productive Malay affixes. [Historical lexical comparison](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/203)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sen.ja 想成白昼与夜晚的交接声：太阳下沉，暮色接班。e 轻读 /ə/。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性词，可用于日常交谈、新闻及文学。称长者处于 usia senja 时带有委婉或文学色彩，直接称呼个人仍须顾及对方感受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 黄昏常接近穆斯林的昏礼时段，但 senja 并非准确的礼拜时间术语。安排活动时应说明具体时间；部分家庭有黄昏前回家的习惯，不能据此概括所有马来西亚家庭。
